data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to detect when the app enters background or foreground mode.
data.what_it_does: It listens to app lifecycle changes and provides a stream indicating whether the application is currently running in the background or foreground. The plugin supports Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to run specific logic when the app enters the background.
You need to detect when the app returns to the foreground.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
You require complex state management solutions beyond simple lifecycle detection.
strengths: Simple stream-based API for monitoring background and foreground transitions.
Easy integration with minimal boilerplate code.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
Minimal documentation and features beyond basic detection.
